jobs.description: 공장설립온라인지원시스템(팩토리온) 분양 및 처분신청 공고 (root ADR-0603 §8; scripts/ops/industrial-land-sale-notice-collect.sh factoryon): the widest list (1,567 notices measured 2026-11-22: 한국산업단지공단 and its branches' 처분신청, 시도, 시군, 공사, K-water, 한국농어촌공사, private developers), collected by the owner's decision of 2026-11-22 knowing its robots.txt disallows /bbs/, at the least load: once a day, one request after another (no pause between them, one in flight: the owner's decision of 2026-11-23), the whole history once, then list page 1 and only the new notices' pages (lttotNdDspsPblancDetail.do) and attachments (atchFileDownload.do). Any 4xx, 429 or a page that is not the one asked for stops the run at once: it commits what it read and fails, so it is seen, and asks nothing more until the next day. Partial: the notices the lakehouse does not record as read with the same list fingerprint (silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read), newest first, every one of them in one run (no count or time cap per run; a run that settles nothing for the contract's stall_minutes commits what it read and fails, so it is seen; root ADR-0603, 2026-11-23 revision), one request after another; the list walk stops at the first page that owes nothing once the reads cover the count the provider states. Each attachment still in use is downloaded and stored once, whatever its format, in the shared content-addressed media store; the details land in Bronze as served, one read at a time through the one Bronze line writer, which closes a content-qualified object (root ADR-0152) every close_after_seconds (bronze-line-objects.contract.json), each attachment annotated with its hash, format, size, source URL and outcome. Reads nothing inside the files. No Spark.
jobs.memory_measured: 977.6M peak (and 383.9M swap) in its first run, 2026-11-22 18:52-22:22Z, under the 1G cap: one detail and its attachments in memory (256 MiB per-file cap, industrial-land-sale-notice.contract.json attachments.max_file_bytes) plus one batch of 50 reads; the peak is the largest file, not the run's length; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: runs no DuckDB stage (none of the publisher's stage commands is in its unit's scripts), so the stage's open check never reads it; 1G is its share of a task's disk on AWS beside its state_paths.

first_run.estimated_from: measured 2026-11-22 18:52-22:22Z on ai-server: 508 notices and 980 attachments (1.54 GB) in 1,539 requests over 12,629 s, of which 10,766 s were the seven-second waits now removed, so about 1.21 s a request asked back to back; the whole list (1,067 notices that run) is about 3,233 requests, about 3,900 s from an empty ledger, inside the 6,480 s share of the 120-minute limit; after the first fill a run is list page 1 and the new notices.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: The provider publishes notices on no fixed day (endpoint catalog expected_cadence irregular, group industrial_land_sale_notice); that the job runs and finishes is its done expectation (root ADR-0480 §1).
expected_outcome.landed_basis: the board keeps a notice only while its provider lists it (endpoint catalog provider_retention, group industrial_land_sale_notice). 30 h = one daily turn + the 120-minute limit + room for a late start; how soon a post leaves the board is not measured (root ADR-0614).

jobs.description: LH 토지 공고 through data.go.kr (root ADR-0603; scripts/ops/industrial-land-sale-notice-collect.sh lh): the land notice list (lhLeaseNoticeInfo1, kind 01, the whole history window; each answer lands in Bronze when it changed), and per owed notice its detail (lhLeaseNoticeDtlInfo1, whose dsAhflInfo lists the attachments on apply.lh.or.kr) and supply list (lhLeaseNoticeSplInfo1: per 필지 its use, address, lot number, area and planned price) kept as one read. Without the platform's data.go.kr service key, or while the gateway refuses the three services, the run ends with 78 before writing anything. Partial: the notices the lakehouse does not record as read with the same list fingerprint (silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read), newest first, every one of them in one run (no count or time cap per run; a run that settles nothing for the contract's stall_minutes commits what it read and fails, so it is seen; root ADR-0603, 2026-11-23 revision), one request after another (no pause, one in flight); the list walk stops at the first page that owes nothing once the reads cover the count the provider states. Each attachment still in use is downloaded and stored once, whatever its format, in the shared content-addressed media store; the details land in Bronze as served, one read at a time through the one Bronze line writer, which closes a content-qualified object (root ADR-0152) every close_after_seconds (bronze-line-objects.contract.json), each attachment annotated with its hash, format, size, source URL and outcome. jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-22, root ADR-0603); sized as the ILIS notice collector (1G), which keeps one detail and its attachments in memory as this one does, under the same 256 MiB per-file cap (industrial-land-sale-notice.contract.json attachments.max_file_bytes), plus at most one batch of 50 reads (a KICOX post page is about 170 KB, a Factory-on notice page about 60 KB); systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Never run: off by the owner's decision (2026-11-23: not now; disabled_reason). No per-run cap bounds it (root ADR-0603, 2026-11-23 revision), so the pull request that switches it on sets time_limit_minutes from its first measured full history.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: The provider publishes land notices on no fixed day (endpoint catalog expected_cadence irregular, group industrial_land_sale_notice); that the job runs and finishes is its done expectation (root ADR-0480 §1).
expected_outcome.no_landed_bound_reason: Never switched on: the provider's gateway refuses until the usage application is approved (disabled_reason, root ADR-0603 §6), so there is no read to keep up. The PR that enables the job declares landed_within_hours with its first answered list (root ADR-0614).

jobs.disabled_reason: Waiting for the owner's data.go.kr usage application (활용신청) for the three 한국토지주택공사 services 분양임대공고문 조회 (15058530), 분양임대공고별 상세정보 조회 (15057999) and 분양임대공고별 공급정보 조회 (15056765), auto-approved; the service key itself exists (runtime-secrets group data-go-kr). Until then the gateway refuses and the collector ends with 78; the PR that enables this job cites its first answered list (root ADR-0603 §6).

jobs.description: Silver load of the industrial land sale notice reads and attachments (root ADR-0603; scripts/ops/industrial-land-sale-notice-silver-load.sh, the publisher's load-industrial-land-sale-notice-silver, DuckDB inside the publisher and its own Iceberg append, root ADR-0559): the detail objects of the three sources (ILIS, KICOX, LH) that no commit of silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read records (plan-silver-load-objects, R2 alone), oldest first, each committed on its own: first its attachments in the store to silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_attachment (new or changed (source, notice, hash) only; the index the media reconciler reads the store through), then one read row per notice to silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read. Both tables are born on their first commit. `unchanged` without starting the load when nothing is owed; no Spark.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-22, root ADR-0603); sized as the ILIS notice Silver load (512M), the same DuckDB stage and append over objects of the same size; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: computed bound for a job whose command opens a DuckDB stage over tables of thousands to millions of rows (its stage database and staged files). The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the ILIS notice Silver load, the same DuckDB stage and append (2.0 s an object measured 2026-11-18 on ai-server over 884 production objects, R2 fetch included): the first fill leaves about 35 objects (741 + 962 notices, 50 to an object), about 70 s, and 600 s stays the bound until a production run is measured, inside the 2,160 s share of the 40-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when a collector wrote a notice object; that it is not behind its inputs is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333).

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고
assets.description: 산업용지 분양·처분·공급 공고와 그 첨부를 네 원천에서 받는다: 공장설립온라인 분양 및 처분신청 공고(가장 넓다, 하루 한 번, 사장 결정), ILIS 분양공고(전국 등록부, 매시), 한국산업단지공단 임대/분양 게시판(공단 자체 단지·임대, 매시), LH 토지 공고(data.go.kr, 활용신청 전까지 꺼짐). 루트 ADR-0603.

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고 읽은 기록
assets.description: 네 원천의 분양공고 상세를 읽을 때마다(실패 포함) 공고 하나에 한 행을 쌓는다: 원천·공고 id·목록 지문·물은 시각·결과·첨부 수. 수집기가 다음 실행에 물을 공고를 이 표에서 계산한다(루트 ADR-0603).

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고 첨부
assets.description: 공고마다 그 첨부(PDF·HWP·HWPX·ZIP·그림, 그 밖은 bin)를 내용 해시로 한 번씩 쌓는다: 파일 이름·제공자 id·크기·출처 URL·받은 시각·형식·바이트 수. 바이트는 공용 content-addressed 미디어 저장소에 한 번만 있다(루트 ADR-0298, ADR-0603). 미디어 대조기가 이 색인으로 저장소를 맞춘다.

dependencies.description: 아직 같은 목록 지문으로 읽지 않은 공고의 상세를 새 것부터 묻고 읽은 기록을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0603).
공고의 첨부를 형식에 상관없이 받아 공용 미디어 저장소에 내용 해시로 한 번만 담고, 색인을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0603).
수집기가 매 실행 이 표의 마지막 읽음으로 물을 공고를 계산한다: 목록의 공고 중 마지막 읽음이 같은 목록 지문의 read 가 아닌 것, 새 것부터(루트 ADR-0603 §3).
